requirements.requirement: Operate two pumps in lead/standby; one pump demanded when permitted.
requirements.note: Retained native sequencer and custom command gates; native execution untested.

requirements.requirement: Rank pump lead preference by least proven run hours.
requirements.note: Native proof-driven totalizers feed native sequencer rank ports; no native totalizer/sequencer execution.

requirements.requirement: Rotate pumps on an adjustable weekly schedule.
requirements.note: PUMP-WEEKLY-ROT pulse input exists; no calendar or supervisory binding.

requirements.requirement: Upon lead pump failure, start standby, shut failed pump off, initiate BMS alarm.
requirements.note: Custom failure removes availability and output; native reselection and BMS alarm route not executed/complete.

requirements.requirement: Exclude a pump for maintenance and select an available standby.
requirements.note: PUMP-A/B-MAINT interfaces; external command binding pending.

requirements.requirement: Open lead HX process isolation valve; close lag after adjustable 300 seconds.
requirements.note: Off delay anchored at duty deselection; fault/manual isolation bypasses overlap. Proof transfer/rollback approval outstanding.

requirements.requirement: Modulate operating pump VFD to maintain system DP setpoint.
requirements.note: Retained native DP PI; 10 psi source setpoint and 20% minimum are provisional.

requirements.requirement: Modulate duty HX building valve to maintain common process-header leaving water temperature; obtain LWT setpoint from T5-M6.2.1.
requirements.note: Header CT-PCHWS-T wired to cloned native temperature PI; 65 F retained provisionally. Referenced mechanical sheet absent.

requirements.requirement: Provide high/low supply temperature alarms when >SP+5 F or <SP-5 F for 5 minutes.
requirements.note: Custom outputs only; BMS event object/routing pending.
requirements.adjustability_gap: Submittal threshold/differential is adjustable; candidate encodes 5 F temperature band / 25% DP band as fixed graph constants, without dedicated operator adjustment inputs.

requirements.requirement: Provide continuous N+1 HX duty/standby operation; one exchanger sufficient.
requirements.note: One-HX demand with enable guards; both-unavailable/start order policy remains undefined.

requirements.requirement: Rotate duty/standby HX on a user-adjustable monthly schedule.
requirements.note: HX-MONTHLY-ROT pulse input and native duty hours exist. Calendar, freshness and selection criterion incomplete.

requirements.requirement: BMS manual HX isolation closes process isolation and building modulating valve.
requirements.note: HX-A/B-ISOLATE custom inputs; manual isolation bypasses overlap; BMS binding pending.

requirements.requirement: Building control valve failure closes both valves, removes HX from service and requests next available HX.
requirements.note: Custom failure/availability path and proof gating exist; physical valve feedback is SIM-only; native rotation untested.

requirements.requirement: Define control valve failure as commanded/position deviation by adjustable 10% for adjustable 120 s.
requirements.note: Recipe uses >=10%, source says by 10%; boundary and manual reset remain provisional.

requirements.requirement: Isolation failure when commanded open/closed switch closed or commanded closed/open switch open for adjustable 30 s; remove HX and rotate.
requirements.note: Both/neither proof and bad-quality policies not specified; proof inputs SIM-only.

requirements.requirement: Monitor building and process supply/return water temperatures.
requirements.note: Eight mapped RTDs have incompatible retained Nickel setup. Two individual HX process RTDs are SIM-only.

requirements.requirement: Monitor flow from process equipment.
requirements.note: Mapped XPM-2 UI1 retains 0-10 V/0..100; signal selection/full-scale/units unresolved.

requirements.requirement: High BTU alarm when measurement >trended average plus adjustable 10%; establish initial setpoint during commissioning.
requirements.note: Comparator implemented; BTU-MEAS/AVERAGE/DATA-VALID are external contracts only. Calculation, energy totalization, history/baseline and commissioning missing.

requirements.requirement: Pump failure alarm when commanded on and status off.
requirements.note: Provisional 30 s proof delay; manually reset latch; physical proof mapped.

requirements.requirement: Pump hand alarm when commanded off and status on.
requirements.note: Provisional 30 s delay and run-permission gate; clears on normalization. Alarm disabled when configuration/system permission is false.

requirements.requirement: Provide pump VFD fault alarm.
requirements.note: Fault SIM inputs remove pump command immediately; physical fault inputs and BMS delivery not implemented.

requirements.requirement: High DP alarm when DP >1.25*SP for adjustable 2 minutes.
requirements.adjustability_gap: Submittal threshold/differential is adjustable; candidate encodes 5 F temperature band / 25% DP band as fixed graph constants, without dedicated operator adjustment inputs.

requirements.requirement: Low DP alarm when DP <0.75*SP for adjustable 2 minutes.
requirements.adjustability_gap: Submittal threshold/differential is adjustable; candidate encodes 5 F temperature band / 25% DP band as fixed graph constants, without dedicated operator adjustment inputs.

requirements.requirement: Provide low flow alarm.
requirements.note: No threshold, delay, units or enable/reset policy specified; LOWFLOW-SP=0 disables alarm; provisional delay 30 s.

requirements.requirement: Confirm signal quality handling, failure latches/reset, startup, power/communications restart and all-unavailable behavior.
Create all 35 scheduled hardwired points on the assigned devices/terminals.
Provide M4-DLK0350-0 local display on SA bus address 3.
Provide Pump VFD kW for each of two VFDs.
Provide software LWT and DP setpoints and CT water BTU meter.
